name: remit
description: Your agent reaches the cloud only through a warrant a person signed: it can see and check its warrant, runs cloud commands through Remit's broker with short-lived credentials stamped with the warrant, and is stopped from calling cloud CLIs directly.

chain.title: Warrant chain
chain.description: The warrant chain the agent works under (remit warrant issue or delegate).

root.title: Trusted root key
root.description: The key identifier the chain must start at, for example ed25519:... (remit key id).

role.title: Role ARN
role.description: The role the broker assumes; its trust policy must require a Remit warrant id as source identity.

log_policy.title: Log trust policy
log_policy.description: The trust policy the chain's log checkpoint must satisfy (SPEC 9.2).

log_proof.title: Logged proof
log_proof.description: The proof that every link of the chain is logged (remit log prove).

region.title: Region
region.description: The region for STS and for commands.

allow.title: Program remit_run may start
allow.description: The one program remit_run may start, by name.
